description: This Java source file defines a final class `GatewayQueryTimeExceededException` which extends `DittoRuntimeException`. It represents a specific type of exception indicating that an HTTP query took too long. The class includes static factory methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, as well as an inner builder class for constructing instances with a fluent API. The exception is annotated with `@Immutable` and implements `GatewayException`. It includes metadata like error code and HTTP status code and references various other classes in the project related to JSON parsing, headers, and exceptions.
